title.en: Swap tokens on Uniswap, with a signed Permit2 allowance
title.zh-TW: 用 Uniswap 兌換代幣，附上簽好的 Permit2 授權

summary.en: The Safe calls `execute` on Uniswap's Universal Router. It first uses `PERMIT2_PERMIT` to hand over a Permit2 allowance the Safe's signers signed beforehand (to the router, 2^160-1; the template leaves the expiry free), then runs `V4_SWAP`: in one v4 pool with no hook, it sells the amount you type, and all of the bought token goes to the Safe. The router's allowance in Permit2 stays after the transaction.
summary.zh-TW: Safe 呼叫 Uniswap Universal Router 的 `execute`，先用 `PERMIT2_PERMIT` 交出 Safe 簽署人事先簽好的 Permit2 授權（給 router，2^160-1，到期時間模板不限），再 `V4_SWAP`：在一個沒有 hook 的 v4 池子，把你填的數量賣掉，買進的代幣全部給 Safe。Permit2 裡給 router 的授權交易後留著。

text.en: The template binds the swap, but most sampled direct swaps are encoded differently and would be MISMATCH. The Permit2 allowance is signed separately; kiss-sign does not check that step.
text.zh-TW: 模板綁住兌換本身，但抽樣的直接兌換多半編碼不同，會是 MISMATCH；Permit2 授權另外簽，kiss-sign 不檢查那一步。

pastTxsConclusion.en: No sampled Safe transaction fits. 3 of the 4 tagged one-pool permit swaps use v4 actions 0x0b060e, the template expects 0x070b0e. Each search stopped at its cap after 3.8, 1.3 or 2.4 days. Of 240 in the permit search, 156 called another router, 0x66a9893cC07D91D95644AEDD05D03f95e1dBA8Af, and 55 this one.
pastTxsConclusion.zh-TW: 抽樣的 Safe 交易沒有一筆符合。帶標記、用 permit 的單池兌換 4 筆有 3 筆用 v4 動作 0x0b060e，模板要 0x070b0e。搜尋到上限就停，只涵蓋 3.8、1.3、2.4 天。permit 搜尋的 240 筆裡 156 筆呼叫別的 router，55 筆呼叫這個。

intro.en: Uniswap: a decentralized exchange. All v4 pools live in one PoolManager contract.
intro.zh-TW: Uniswap：去中心化交易所；v4 的池子都在同一個 PoolManager 合約裡。

text.en: The v4 core contracts and the Universal Router have public audit reports in their repos (v4 core: OpenZeppelin, Spearbit, Certora, ABDK, Trail of Bits; router: OpenZeppelin, Spearbit, ABDK). The router folder names 2.1 and no report names 2.1.2. I read the file lists, not the reports.
text.zh-TW: v4 核心合約和 Universal Router 的 repo 裡有公開的審計報告（v4 核心：OpenZeppelin、Spearbit、Certora、ABDK、Trail of Bits；router：OpenZeppelin、Spearbit、ABDK）。router 資料夾有標 2.1 的報告，沒有標 2.1.2 的。我只看了檔案清單，沒讀報告內容。

text.en: Most sampled one-pool swaps are encoded differently from this template and would be MISMATCH. Of 4 tagged permit swaps through one pool, 3 use v4 actions 0x0b060e (pay, then swap), one of them USDT to USDC; 1 uses the template's 0x070b0e and buys ETH, outside the registry. No sampled Safe transaction fits: one with a permit adds a command and a hook pool, one that approved instead also uses 0x0b060e. The tag (unix bytes after the call) does not prove the app sent it. The searches stopped at their cap, after 1.3 to 3.8 days.
text.zh-TW: 抽樣的單池兌換多半和模板編碼不同，會 MISMATCH。帶 unix 標記的 permit 單池兌換 4 筆：3 筆動作是 0x0b060e，含 USDT 換 USDC；1 筆是模板的 0x070b0e，買登記外的 ETH。Safe 沒有一筆符合：permit 那筆多指令又走 hook 池，approve 那筆也是 0x0b060e。標記不算證明；搜尋到上限就停，只有 1.3 到 3.8 天。

recommendation.en: Expect a MISMATCH when the actions are 0x0b060e; do not sign past it. What the app sends for a Safe today was not established; the one Safe transaction seen with 0x070b0e and a permit is of 2026-10-07.
recommendation.zh-TW: 動作是 0x0b060e 時會是 MISMATCH，不要硬簽。app 現在替 Safe 送什麼沒有確認；看過用 permit 加 0x070b0e 的 Safe 交易是 2026-10-07 那筆。

text.en: The Permit2 allowance this transaction uses is a Safe message (EIP-1271) that the Safe's signers signed beforehand, and kiss-sign does not check that step. The template binds the allowance's contents in the transaction, and its permit command has no allow-failure flag, so when Permit2 rejects the signature the router reverts the whole transaction. But an allowance you were tricked into signing for someone else can be used without this transaction.
text.zh-TW: 這筆交易用的 Permit2 授權是 Safe 簽署人事先簽的 Safe 訊息（EIP-1271），kiss-sign 不檢查那一步。交易裡的授權內容模板有綁住，permit 指令也沒有容許失敗的旗標，所以 Permit2 不收簽名時 router 讓整筆交易失敗；但被騙簽給別人的授權，不需要這筆交易就能被用掉。

recommendation.en: When you sign the Permit2 message, check that the spender is Universal Router 0x23617e59A5925b2A4Bf75d73ff6711cD0b29De85.
recommendation.zh-TW: 簽 Permit2 訊息時確認 spender 是 Universal Router 0x23617e59A5925b2A4Bf75d73ff6711cD0b29De85。

text.en: You type the card's minimum to receive yourself, and it is the only price protection. The app picks the pool (fee and tick spacing); the template only requires no hook, and anyone can open a v4 pool. Below the minimum the router makes the transaction fail, and verify also gives MISMATCH. The trading API calculates the app's automatic slippage for each quote, and no view on chain reads it.
text.zh-TW: 「最少收到的數量」要你自己填，它是唯一的價格保護。池子（手續費和 tick 間距）由 app 選，模板只要求沒有 hook，而任何人都能開 v4 池子；少於最少數量，router 讓交易失敗，verify 也會 MISMATCH。自動滑價由交易 API 每次報價時算，鏈上沒有一個 view 讀得到。

recommendation.en: Type the minimum to receive shown on the app's confirm screen. Do not type a lower one.
recommendation.zh-TW: 照 app 確認畫面上的最少收到數量填，不要填得更低。

text.en: Allowances stay after the transaction: the 2^160-1 allowance to the Universal Router inside Permit2, until its expiration, and whatever the Safe allowed Permit2 itself on the token. In the router's source every Permit2 pull takes from the address that called it, so others cannot use the Safe's allowance through the router.
text.zh-TW: 交易後會留下授權：Permit2 裡給 Universal Router 的 2^160-1 授權，到到期為止，以及 Safe 先前在代幣上給 Permit2 的額度。原始碼裡 router 每次透過 Permit2 拉代幣，都是從呼叫它的地址拉，所以別人不能透過 router 用 Safe 的授權。

recommendation.en: Acceptable. To revoke, call approve(Permit2, 0) on the token, or call lockdown on Permit2.
recommendation.zh-TW: 可以接受；想收回時，對代幣呼叫 approve(Permit2, 0)，或在 Permit2 呼叫 lockdown。

text.zh-TW: Etherscan 地址頁列出的創建交易

1.execute.commands.en: The list of commands, one command per byte. 0x0a is `PERMIT2_PERMIT` (use a signed Permit2 allowance), 0x10 is `V4_SWAP` (one v4 swap).
1.execute.commands.zh-TW: 指令清單，每個 byte 一個指令。0x0a 是 `PERMIT2_PERMIT`（用簽好的 Permit2 授權），0x10 是 `V4_SWAP`（一次 v4 兌換）。

1.execute.inputs.en: One set of parameters per command, in the same order as the command list.
1.execute.inputs.zh-TW: 每個指令一份參數，順序和指令清單一樣。

1.execute.inputs[1].en: The parameters of `V4_SWAP`: the list of v4 actions and each action's parameters.
1.execute.inputs[1].zh-TW: `V4_SWAP` 的參數：v4 動作清單和每個動作的參數。

1.execute.inputs[1].V4_SWAP.actions.en: The list of v4 actions: 0x07 `SWAP_EXACT_IN` (swap by the input amount), 0x0b `SETTLE` (pay the token sold), 0x0e `TAKE` (take the token bought).
1.execute.inputs[1].V4_SWAP.actions.zh-TW: v4 動作清單：0x07 `SWAP_EXACT_IN`（照輸入數量兌換）、0x0b `SETTLE`（付出賣的代幣）、0x0e `TAKE`（領走買到的代幣）。

1.execute.inputs[1].V4_SWAP.params.en: One set of parameters for each of the three actions.

1.execute.inputs[1].V4_SWAP.params[0].SW.en: What the swap does: what to sell, which pool it goes through, how much to sell, and the least to get.
1.execute.inputs[1].V4_SWAP.params[0].SW.zh-TW: 兌換的內容：賣什麼、經過哪個池子、賣多少、最少要拿到多少。

1.execute.inputs[1].V4_SWAP.params[0].SW.en: The pools it goes through, one item per pool. The template accepts only one pool.
1.execute.inputs[1].V4_SWAP.params[0].SW.zh-TW: 經過的池子，一個池子一項；模板只接受一個池子。

1.execute.inputs[1].V4_SWAP.params[0].SW.en: That pool: the token on the other side, the fee, the tick spacing, the hook.
1.execute.inputs[1].V4_SWAP.params[0].SW.zh-TW: 那個池子：另一邊的代幣、手續費、tick 間距、hook。

1.execute.inputs[1].V4_SWAP.params[0].SW.en: The token this hop swaps into, that is, the token bought.
1.execute.inputs[1].V4_SWAP.params[0].SW.zh-TW: 這一跳換到的代幣，也就是買進的代幣。

1.execute.inputs[1].V4_SWAP.params[0].SW.en: The pool's fee tier, in millionths, set when the app picks the route. Seen: 7 and 8 for USDC/USDT in the Safe test transactions, 100 in the one past transaction that fits. Another value means another pool, or a pool that does not exist.
1.execute.inputs[1].V4_SWAP.params[0].SW.zh-TW: 池子的手續費等級（百萬分之幾），app 選路由時決定。看過：Safe 測試交易的 USDC／USDT 是 7、8，唯一符合的歷史交易是 100。換成別的值就是別的池子或不存在的池子。

1.execute.inputs[1].V4_SWAP.params[0].SW.en: The pool's tick spacing. Together with the fee, it decides which pool this is. It was 1 in the Safe test transactions and in the one past transaction that fits.
1.execute.inputs[1].V4_SWAP.params[0].SW.zh-TW: 池子的 tick 間距，和手續費一起決定是哪個池子；Safe 測試交易和唯一符合的歷史交易都是 1。

1.execute.inputs[1].V4_SWAP.params[0].SW.en: The pool's hook contract. The zero address means no hook, so no extra contract runs during the swap.
1.execute.inputs[1].V4_SWAP.params[0].SW.zh-TW: 池子的 hook 合約；零地址代表沒有 hook，兌換時不會跑任何額外的合約。

1.execute.inputs[1].V4_SWAP.params[0].SW.en: Data for the hook. There is no hook, so it is empty.
1.execute.inputs[1].V4_SWAP.params[0].SW.zh-TW: 給 hook 的資料；沒有 hook，所以是空的。

1.execute.inputs[1].V4_SWAP.params[0].SW.en: The lowest price for each hop, optional. It can only make the transaction fail when the price is too poor. It was empty in the Safe test transactions and in the one past transaction that fits.
1.execute.inputs[1].V4_SWAP.params[0].SW.zh-TW: 每一跳的最低價格，可有可無；只會讓價格太差時交易失敗。Safe 測試交易和唯一符合的歷史交易都是空的。

1.execute.inputs[1].V4_SWAP.params[0].SW.en: The amount to sell, in the token's base units.
1.execute.inputs[1].V4_SWAP.params[0].SW.zh-TW: 賣出的數量，以代幣的最小單位計。

1.execute.inputs[1].V4_SWAP.params[0].SW.en: The least amount of the bought token to get. Below this, the router makes the whole transaction fail.
1.execute.inputs[1].V4_SWAP.params[0].SW.zh-TW: 最少要拿到的買進代幣數量；少於這個數，router 讓整筆交易失敗。

1.execute.inputs[1].V4_SWAP.params[1].SE.en: The token to pay to the pool, that is, the token sold.
1.execute.inputs[1].V4_SWAP.params[1].SE.zh-TW: 要付給池子的代幣，也就是賣出的代幣。

1.execute.inputs[1].V4_SWAP.params[1].SE.en: 0 means pay the full amount the swap owes, that is, `amountIn`.
1.execute.inputs[1].V4_SWAP.params[1].SE.zh-TW: 0 代表付清兌換欠下的全部數量，也就是 `amountIn`。

1.execute.inputs[1].V4_SWAP.params[1].SE.en: true means the Safe that calls the router pays; the router pulls the token from the Safe through Permit2.
1.execute.inputs[1].V4_SWAP.params[1].SE.zh-TW: true 代表由呼叫 router 的 Safe 付款，router 透過 Permit2 從 Safe 拉代幣。

1.execute.inputs[1].V4_SWAP.params[2].TA.en: The token to take, that is, the token bought.
1.execute.inputs[1].V4_SWAP.params[2].TA.zh-TW: 要領走的代幣，也就是買進的代幣。

1.execute.inputs[1].V4_SWAP.params[2].TA.en: Who receives the bought token. It must be the Safe itself.
1.execute.inputs[1].V4_SWAP.params[2].TA.zh-TW: 誰收到買進的代幣；必須是 Safe 自己。

1.execute.inputs[1].V4_SWAP.params[2].TA.en: 0 means take the full amount the swap gives.
1.execute.inputs[1].V4_SWAP.params[2].TA.zh-TW: 0 代表領走兌換得到的全部數量。

1.execute.deadline.en: After this time the router refuses the swap. It was about 29 minutes after the proposal in the Safe test transaction, and about 30 minutes after the block in the one past transaction that fits.
1.execute.deadline.zh-TW: 過了這個時間 router 就拒絕這筆兌換。Safe 測試交易是提案後約 29 分鐘，唯一符合的歷史交易是區塊時間後約 30 分鐘。

1.execute.inputs[0].en: The parameters of `PERMIT2_PERMIT`: the Permit2 allowance the Safe's signers signed beforehand, and that signature.
1.execute.inputs[0].zh-TW: `PERMIT2_PERMIT` 的參數：Safe 的簽署人事先簽好的 Permit2 授權，和那份簽名。

1.execute.inputs[0].PERMIT2_PERMIT.permi.en: The contents of the signed allowance.
The allowance's token, amount, expiry and nonce.
1.execute.inputs[0].PERMIT2_PERMIT.permi.zh-TW: 授權的代幣、數量、到期時間和 nonce。

1.execute.inputs[0].PERMIT2_PERMIT.permi.en: The token the allowance is for, that is, the token sold.
1.execute.inputs[0].PERMIT2_PERMIT.permi.zh-TW: 授權的代幣，也就是賣出的代幣。

1.execute.inputs[0].PERMIT2_PERMIT.permi.en: The allowance amount, 2^160-1, Permit2's unlimited, as in the Safe test transaction and the one past transaction that fits.
1.execute.inputs[0].PERMIT2_PERMIT.permi.zh-TW: 授權數量 2^160-1，Permit2 的無上限；Safe 測試交易和唯一符合的歷史交易都是這個數。

1.execute.inputs[0].PERMIT2_PERMIT.permi.en: When the allowance expires. It was 30 days ahead in the Safe test transaction and in the one past transaction that fits; the verify page shows it.
1.execute.inputs[0].PERMIT2_PERMIT.permi.zh-TW: 授權到期時間；Safe 測試交易和唯一符合的歷史交易都是約 30 天後，verify 的網頁會顯示。

1.execute.inputs[0].PERMIT2_PERMIT.permi.en: Permit2's nonce for this token and router. It goes up by one each time it is used.
1.execute.inputs[0].PERMIT2_PERMIT.permi.zh-TW: Permit2 對這個代幣和 router 的 nonce，每用一次加一。

1.execute.inputs[0].PERMIT2_PERMIT.permi.en: When this signature stops being valid: 28 minutes after the proposal in the Safe test transaction, 30 minutes after the block in the one past transaction that fits.
1.execute.inputs[0].PERMIT2_PERMIT.permi.zh-TW: 這份簽名的有效期限；Safe 測試交易是提案後 28 分鐘，唯一符合的歷史交易是區塊時間後 30 分鐘。

1.execute.inputs[0].PERMIT2_PERMIT.signa.en: The Safe signers' signature over this allowance. Permit2 checks it through the Safe's `isValidSignature`; if it does not match, the transaction fails.
1.execute.inputs[0].PERMIT2_PERMIT.signa.zh-TW: Safe 簽署人對這份授權的簽名；Permit2 透過 Safe 的 `isValidSignature` 驗證，對不上交易就失敗。
